name: Mafia Dragons
source:
As a child, you were captivated by the fabulous tales your mother told of dragons, only for more mundane concerns to take their place as you grew up. When she fell victim to a random act of gang-related violence, the threat posed by mythical fire-breathing reptiles was certainly the last thing on your mind, until the twist in this tale proves to be covered in very real scales.

What starts as a normal garage sale soon escalates into a vicious power struggle as two rival gangs compete for a precious family heirloom and the secrets it holds about your lineage. When you’re caught in the literal crossfire, survival may depend on setting aside your qualms and fighting tooth and claw beside the lesser of two evils in this underworld mob scene.

Who can you trust though, when everyone seems to have the heart of a cold-blooded criminal?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.dragonmafia]Google Play[/url]]
